name: PCT International Patent Application
aliases: convert this patent application into a pct draft
description: A canonical Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) international patent application filed under the PCT treaty and regulations administered by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO). Establishes an international filing date across all PCT Contracting States, governing the international phase prior to national phase entry.
jurisdiction_notes: Governed by the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT, 1970), Regulations under the PCT, and Administrative Instructions under the PCT administered by WIPO. Operates strictly in the INTERNATIONAL_PHASE. Does NOT grant a 'worldwide patent' or granted national patent rights. National/regional phase entry (Articles 22/39(1)) is required before designated national/regional offices to obtain enforceable patent rights.

required_inputs.label: Title of the Invention
required_inputs.description: Short and precise title indicating the technical subject matter (PCT Rule 4.3)

required_inputs.label: Technical Field
required_inputs.description: Technical field to which the invention relates (PCT Rule 5.1(a)(i))

required_inputs.label: Technical Problem and Solution
required_inputs.description: Underlying technical problem and the core inventive solution

required_inputs.label: Detailed Technical Features and Mechanism
required_inputs.description: Structure, steps, data flow, components, and operation of the invention

optional_inputs.label: Priority Application Records
optional_inputs.description: List of priority records with country/office, application number, and filing date (PCT Rule 4.10)

optional_inputs.label: Applicant Details
optional_inputs.description: Entity/person holding filing entitlement, including name, residence, and nationality (PCT Article 9)

optional_inputs.label: Inventor Details
optional_inputs.description: Natural persons who contributed to the conception of the invention

optional_inputs.label: Receiving Office (RO)
optional_inputs.description: Competent receiving office (e.g., RO/US, RO/IB, RO/EP) under PCT Rule 19

optional_inputs.label: Brief Description of the Drawings
optional_inputs.description: Summary of figures illustrating the invention (PCT Rule 5.1(a)(iv))

optional_inputs.label: Public Disclosures or Prior Sales
optional_inputs.description: Any public disclosure, publication, or commercial sale of the invention

sections.heading: Modes for Carrying Out the Invention
